title: About
headline: I've been building on the web since 2015: first bots and games, then blogs, now full-stack products and AI.
paragraphs: My journey began in **2015**, when I made and ran **Telegram bots** and small **HTML games**. In **2019** I got into **blogging** and learned **WordPress**. I published **10+ websites** that got **Google AdSense** approval, grew to **up to 2 million visits a month**, and picked up real **SEO** experience. When AI took over content writing I lost interest and stopped running the blogs, and in **2021** I moved into development with the **MERN stack**.
During my B.Tech I freelanced for **2+ years**, building and selling websites to clients around the world. That's close to **60 projects**. Alongside it, I prepared for and qualified **GATE**.
After GATE I joined a company as a **full stack engineer**, building **SaaS products**, beautiful award-worthy designs and **AI workflows**.
I also run **two SaaS products** of my own. Right now I'm most excited about **AI agents**, training **LLM models**, and **automation flows** that push leads straight to sales.
Outside work I love **gadgets**. Most of my blog income went into them, and into my desk setup.
